notes.title: ‌April 30th Update Notes‌
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the testers for your feedback!

‌Issues Fixed:‌

Fixed an issue where opening the settings menu (Esc) did not pause the game, and the player character became unresponsive after respawning following death.
Other interaction-related optimizations.

notes.title: Playtest Announcement
notes.notes:
The game testing phase has temporarily concluded. Thank you to all participating players.
Based on feedback received, future development may significantly differ from the current version.
The beta version will remain available, and upcoming updates may include:
[olist]
[*] Modifications or complete overhaul of the point system.
[*] Shop and currency system. Players will be able to purchase items from the shop for use in battles or mini-game levels. Main rewards in mini-games will be replaced with gold coins for purchasing shop items.
[*] Adjustments to other game mechanics and performance optimizations.
[/olist]
I appreciate your continued support as me refine the gaming experience.
